data: Microsoft reported diluted earnings per share of $13.64 for fiscal 2025 (the year ended June 30, 2025), up from $11.80 in fiscal 2024, an increase of about 16% (15.6% precisely). Net income for fiscal 2025 was $101.8 billion ($101,832 million), up roughly 16% from $88.1 billion in fiscal 2024. These figures come from Microsoft's fiscal 2025 annual report; I haven't checked them against a live source in this session, so confirm them against the 10-K if you need exact citation.
